headline: Professional CRM, from entry to detail
overview: Track customers, partners, and professional contacts. Manage pipeline stages, log interactions, and nurture your professional network with a CRM built for career-focused relationship management.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Professional CRM — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the professional contacts list with pipeline stages and contact management interface.
steps.screenshotAlt: Professional CRM landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Manage customers, partners, and professional contacts in one place
Track pipeline stages for deals, opportunities, and relationships
Log interactions and notes to maintain relationship context
Visualize your professional network and pipeline health
tips: Add a brief note after every meaningful professional interaction — even a one-line summary helps you remember context months later.
Use pipeline stages consistently so you can quickly identify which relationships need attention or follow-up.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
